candidates.comment: Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/333046, which tracks Copilot ghost-text suggestions failing in Windows paths containing spaces and includes a minimal reproduction. Your report adds an occurrence on VS Code 1.143.1 with Windows build 26200.

Thanks for the report. This matches the Windows path-with-spaces inline-suggestion failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/333046. Your report adds the save-and-reopen trigger, affected Python files and notebooks, and testing on 1.144.0 and 1.143.1; those details should remain part of the investigation there.

Thanks for the detailed reproduction. This is the same retained scroll-width behavior tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/13516. Your additional case is useful: with `editor.wordWrap: bounded` and `git.blame.editorDecoration.enabled`, moving blame from an overflowing line to a short line leaves horizontal scrolling enabled until the editor is resized.

Thanks for the detailed reproduction. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/340844, which tracks custom subagents rejecting configured model names or IDs. Your Azure case adds useful evidence: azure/Azure/gpt-6-luna appears in the available-model list and succeeds with an explicit task override, but fails when supplied through agent frontmatter; those details should remain part of the investigation there.
